description: Climate at a Glance is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. Climate at a Glance offers access to near-real-time analysis of monthly temperature and precipitation data. The set of tools can help users determine whether, and how much, a given location or area is warming or cooling over time, or if it is experiencing an overall change in precipitation. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Economy, Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
